candidates: Renderer files (e.g., `gitGraphRenderer.js`) are explicitly exempt from vitest unit tests per project convention, but must still be covered by Cypress integration tests. When a PR adds or extends rendering behavior, confirm that Cypress tests are added or updated to exercise the new rendering paths — including mirroring any existing test cases for the new mode.

When adding direction or orientation support to a diagram type, follow the pattern already established by other diagram types in the project (e.g., how `flow` and `class` diagrams implement direction via their parsers and renderers) rather than scattering ad-hoc direction-string comparisons throughout the renderer. Also ensure only the intentionally supported direction tokens are defined in the Jison grammar — for git graphs the valid set is `LR` and `TB`.
